remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600
    -DWINVER=0x600
    -DUSE_NEW_WINE_REGISTER_RESOURCES)

spec2def(qcap.dll qcap.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(qcap registry qcap_classes.idl)

# qcap.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/qcap-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(qcap_shims OBJECT audiorecord.c avico.c avimux.c capturegraph.c filewriter.c qcap_main.c smartteefilter.c v4l.c vfwcapture.c)
target_link_libraries(qcap_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_canunload strmbase strmiids uuid oldnames libole32 liboleaut32 libwinmm libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(qcap_shims)
add_dependencies(qcap_shims wineheaders)
set(QCAP_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/qcap/qcap_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(qcap qcap-cargo qcap.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS qcap_shims psdk qcap_r ${QCAP_REUSED} dxsdk uuid_sources)
